data.title: Accident questionnaire from liability insurer
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG wrote on 6 May 2026 about the car accident of 28 April 2026. The other party has made claims, and you must return a completed questionnaire on how the accident happened within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made claims against your car liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht). To clarify who is at fault, the insurer needs your account of what happened. Fill in the questionnaire and send it back by the deadline shown; the app calculates it from the letter date, counting Monday to Friday without public holidays. The questionnaire itself was not included in the text provided, so check that you received it. If liability or injuries are disputed, consider getting professional advice.
